diagnosis.what_happened: Prose contained a hanging colon lead-in ('ارزیابی داده‌های ۵۱۰ دانش‌آموز نشان می‌دهد:'), tense switching (mixing past and present), mechanical data-dump listicle phrasing, and interpretive speculation ('همبسته با علائم شخصیت مرزی') in Chapter 4.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Writing telegraphic intro lines ending in colons and mechanically chaining raw numbers creates fragmented, non-academic text that reads like an unrefined automated output rather than a polished dissertation chapter.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: All empirical results must be woven into unified, flowing paragraphs without hanging colons. Tense must remain consistently past in Chapter 4 reporting. Interpretive psychopathology belongs in Chapter 5, while Chapter 4 focuses on psychometric descriptions referencing tables formally.
diagnosis.rationale_why: High-standard academic writing demands narrative cohesion, grammatical consistency, and structural restraint in the Results chapter.

desired_behavior: Eradicate all hanging colons, ensure consistent past tense, and write coherent academic prose integrating table references seamlessly.
generalization: Never use hanging colons before reporting paragraphs; write flowing, syntactically unified academic narratives across all empirical chapters.

evidence.observed_value: Hanging colons and mechanical listicle phrasing in Section 4-4
evidence.threshold_value: Zero hanging colons, cohesive academic prose
